what_it_does.text: Smart Tester Solutions Oy is a company registered on 2026-04-06 under the industry code 26510, manufacture of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation, and the tax register records first sales on 2026-08-01 and a first hire on 2026-08-01.

readiness.text: On the radar's rules business readiness is level 2, while technology readiness and investment readiness have no level on those rules.

who_to_meet.text: The who-comes-next lists name Business Finland as a public funder and Helsingin kaupunki, kaupunkiympäristön toimiala as a buyer from similar companies.

what_the_fund_should_do.text: The memo puts it on the watchlist (ocean impact unknown, business readiness Low, investment readiness unknown, thesis fit unknown), so the fund should reassess it when a new public record appears.

whats_missing.text: Gaps on the record: no public evidence for ocean impact; business readiness is Low on the stored evidence; no public evidence for investment readiness; no public evidence for thesis fit.
